derivation: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e.
def: (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake

occurrences.text: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
